mapper.insert: insert into news_favorite (user_id, news_id, create_time) values (#{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.delete: delete from news_favorite where user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and news_id = #{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select nf.id as favoriteId, nf.news_id as newsId, DATE_FORMAT(nf.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, n.title, n.author, n.sources, n.dates, n.hits from news_favorite nf left join New_Notice n on nf.news_id = n.id where nf.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER} order by nf.create_time desc limit #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{pageSize,jdbcType=INTEGER}
select count(*) from news_favorite where news_id = #{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
select count(*) from news_favorite where user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
